column1: # catch, throw, zmathfunc and zstyle+ against zsh 5.9.2's own copies: each
# row is the code run after `autoload -Uz catch throw zmathfunc zstyle+` on
# the line before it, what the run printed, standard error on the same pipe
# and each newline written `~`, and the exit status. Measured 2026-10-05 with
# /opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -f under env -i, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin.
{ throw MyExcept; print notreached } always { if catch MyExcept; then print "caught $CAUGHT"; fi }; print after st=$?
{ throw Other } always { if catch MyExcept; then print mine; elif catch '*'; then print "other $CAUGHT"; fi }; print after
{ throw Other } always { catch My && print mine }; print after-unhandled
f() { throw Deep }; g() { f; print notreached }; { g } always { catch Deep && print "deep $CAUGHT" }; print after
{ print ${undefined?boom} } always { catch '' && print "shell error [$CAUGHT]" }; print after
{ throw A } always { catch A && throw B }; print notreached
{ { throw A } always { catch A && throw B } } always { catch B && print "rethrown $CAUGHT" }; print after
catch '*'; print st=$? ${+CAUGHT} ${+EXCEPTION}
{ throw X } always { print ${+EXCEPTION} $EXCEPTION; catch X; print ${+EXCEPTION} }
setopt extendedglob; { throw abc } always { catch (#i)ABC && print ci }
{ throw x } always { catch x* && print glob }
throw; print st=$?
{ throw 'a b' } always { catch 'a b' && print "spaced [$CAUGHT]" }
whence -w catch throw; alias catch
{ true } always { catch '*'; print st=$? }
zmathfunc; print $(( min(4) )) $(( max(4) )) $(( sum(4) ))
zmathfunc; print $(( min() ))
column2: zsh:2: wrong number of arguments: min()~

column1: zmathfunc; print $(( max() ))
column2: zsh:2: wrong number of arguments: max()~

column1: zmathfunc; print $(( min(2, 2.0) )) $(( max(2.0, 2) ))
zmathfunc a; print st=$?
zstyle+ ':foo:bar' s1 v1 + ':baz' s2 v2 + ':frob' s3 v3a v3b; zstyle -a :foo:bar s1 a; zstyle -a :foo:bar:baz s2 b; zstyle -a :foo:bar:frob s3 c; print -r -- "$a|$b|$c|${#c}"
zstyle+ ':foo' s1 v1 + '' s2 v2; zstyle -s :foo s1 a; zstyle -s :foo s2 b; print -r -- "$a|$b"
zstyle+ ':foo' s1; zstyle -a :foo s1 a; print -r -- "st=$? ${#a}"
zstyle+ ':foo' s1 v1 +':x' s2 v2; zstyle -a :foo s1 a; print -r -- "${(j:,:)a}"; zstyle -s :foo:x s2 b || print none
zstyle+ ':foo' s1 v1 + ; zstyle -s :foo s1 a; print -r -- "$a st=$?"
zstyle+ ':a' s 1 + ':b' t 2 + ':c' u 3; zstyle -s :a:b t x; zstyle -s :a:c u y; zstyle -s :a:b:c u z || print nested-no; print -r -- $x $y
